title: Inbox
intro: WhatsApp chats with your customers, shared by everyone who can see the lead.
notSetUp: WhatsApp is not set up for your agency. Ask us to connect your number: {contact}
problem: WhatsApp is having trouble: new messages may arrive late.
paused: WhatsApp is paused for your agency. New messages are kept, but nothing is sent.
demo: This is the demo: you can read the chats here, but nothing can be sent.
empty: No chats yet. When a customer writes to your WhatsApp number, the chat appears here.
pickChat: Choose a chat to read it.

chat.notFound: This chat doesn't exist, or it isn't one you can see.
chat.pastCustomer: A past customer. Their earlier leads are closed.
chat.windowClosed: You can reply with free text only within 24 hours of their last message. It closed on {closed}. A template can still be sent.
chat.photoExpired: This photo expired before we could save it.
chat.fileFailed: This file could not be saved.
chat.unsupported: This message type can't be shown here. Open it on the phone.
chat.contacts: Shared a contact. Open it on the phone.
chat.windowNever: They haven't written to this number. Start the chat with a template.
chat.replyDemo: This is the demo: nothing can be sent.
chat.replyPaused: WhatsApp is paused for your agency, so replies are off for now.

composer.label: Message
composer.fileType: This kind of file can't be sent on WhatsApp from here. Use a photo, a PDF, a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file, a text file or an MP4 video.
composer.fileSize: This file is over 16 MB, the most WhatsApp takes from here.
composer.captionHint: Your words go with the file as its caption.
composer.limit: Five minutes is the longest a voice note can be. Send it, or cancel.

voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser's settings (the icon beside the address), then press the microphone again.
voice.no_microphone: No microphone was found on this device.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't record voice notes.
voice.too_big: That recording is over 16 MB. Record a shorter one.

failure.not_on_whatsapp: Not sent: this number isn't on WhatsApp.

failure.tier_limit: Not sent: WhatsApp's daily limit for your number was reached.
failure.provider_down: Not sent: WhatsApp couldn't be reached.
failure.unsure: We couldn't confirm this was sent. Check before sending again.
failure.paused: Not sent: WhatsApp is paused for your agency.
failure.file_missing: Not sent: the file is no longer there. Attach it again.

settings.title: WhatsApp
settings.intro: The number your customers message, and how WhatsApp is doing for your agency.
settings.hint: Your WhatsApp number and its state
settings.notSetUp: WhatsApp is not set up for your agency. Ask us to connect your number: {contact}

sendTemplate.description: An approved message to {name}. Pick one and fill its blanks.

sendTemplate.optedOut: They asked to stop WhatsApp messages, so no template can be sent.
sendTemplate.previewLabel: The message as it will read

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Messages you may send when the 24-hour window is closed, or to start a chat. WhatsApp approves each one first, which can take a few minutes to a day.
templates.empty: No template yet. Write one with New template, or ask us to add yours.
templates.archiveDescription: It leaves the list staff choose from. It is not deleted at WhatsApp.

form.description: WhatsApp reads it before anyone can send it.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lower case, with underscores, such as booking_update. It can't be changed later.
form.utilityHint: About a booking or trip someone already has.
form.marketingHint: Offers and promotions. Counted against the month's limit.
form.bodyHint: Write a blank as '{{'1'}}', '{{'2'}}' and so on. At most {max} characters. No blank at the very start or end, and none right next to another.

problems.edge: A blank can't be the very first or last thing in the message.
problems.adjacent: Two blanks can't sit right next to each other.
problems.samples: Give an example for each blank.
problems.name: Use lower case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
